evidence_quote: Using a modified grounded theory approach, we examined decision making among eligible individuals who enrolled (trial participants (TPs), n = 32) and those that declined enrollment (non-participants (NPs), n = 5) across two phase 1 COVID-19 vaccine trials conducted during the pandemic (Nova Scotia, Canada; 2021–2023).
rationale: The study examines enrollment decisions and retention in COVID-19 vaccine trials. It does not address cancer biology, tumor progression, tumor biomarkers, or experimental or clinical cancer treatments.
